options: We need to find a safe route to the research institute.
Elysium?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Looks like my equipment's not working right, it can't detect the precise range of the contamination.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I think this is the miners' accommodation. The real danger here might be whoever's still around, really. This is demonic contamination we're talking about.

spans.text: I think this is the miners' accommodation. The real danger here might be whoever's still around, really. This

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Captain says there's no trace of any mental activity in the entire mine, human or animal.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: At the very least, the contamination hasn't blocked the way to the institute. It's mostly headed south, actually.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: We can swing a detour around the north. It'll take us roughly three hours longer than the original plan, but the time loss will be manageable.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: (Nods)

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Wow...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I've been thinking this for a while now, but you two work really well together!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Elysium and Mantra have been working together for many years now.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Hahaha... You could say I'm Rhodes Island's most experienced operator when it comes to working with the captain.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: It takes a lot out of her to 'speak', so if it's not an emergency, I get to be the one passing on the message.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: So, what do you think, Doctor? If we set off now, we should make it before sunset—

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Not that the sun sets in the Ursine Far North this time of year...

options: We set off right now.
Get our friend up to speed on our detour.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Don't fall behind now, Eloysius.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Sorry, was just inspecting the mine equipment, nothing to do with our travels together.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: What's going on? Why did you stop for so long?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: According to the map, we're very close to the institute. Don't tell me you've found some—

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: ...thing?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: It's... traces of Dominion.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: The Royal Guard was here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You don't seem shocked?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I hope you're not insinuating I'm hiding something, Gospozha Amiya, or I'd be very hurt.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I hope you share any pertinent information with us, at least while we are collaborating.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What do you know about the whereabouts of the Royal Guard?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: First of all, only the Tsar himself has the authority to know the comings and goings of the Royal Guard, let alone a lowly sergeant such as myself.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: But honestly speaking, after the illustrious Grand Duchess of the Far North declared martial law and shut down the mines, the Royal Guard showing up would not be much of a shock.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Then, if they're already conducting an investigation of their own here, where does that leave you?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: You're a clever one, aren't you?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: The news of abnormal Infected miners in Central Far North has made waves, and many are curious.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Naturally, while most Ursine have a right to curiosity, they do not have the same right to information.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Please understand that, as a sergeant, I am limited in what I am allowed to say. I hope my explanation will not cause too much confusion, Gospozha Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, it's fine. I understand the position you are in.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I've never minced words about how this job could improve the résumé of an Imperial Guardswoman like me.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Though I did imagine it being much easier...

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Anyhow, that dream is dead. The Royal Guard being involved is a bad omen, no matter how you look at it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If that's the case, are you still set on traveling with us?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Of course. I chose to take on this task, and quitting halfway would hardly be the decent thing to do.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Before we continue onwards, shall we reaffirm our trust in one another?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I look forward to our continued cooperation.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Just like the time we met...

options: Elysium! Give us some direction!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Mierda... The signal's all laggy, it's like there's something interfering with our encrypted frequency!

spans.text: ... The signal's all laggy, it's like there's something interfering with our encrypted frequency!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Whatever, not important... Ten guardsmen to your west, turn right at the next crossing!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: What are you talking about?! The west is on our right!

spans.text: What are you talking about?! The west

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Did I say right? Gah—

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Do you see the city hall? Go in the opposite direction!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I see it, but the crossing ahead is where the plates are disconnected—

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: There's nothing like that on this stupid map!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Well, you're practically surrounded by guards, so that's your only way out!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Got it.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Can you keep up, Amiya?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Hold on tight, Doctor!

options: Doing my best here—

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Your best isn't good enough. Fine, I'll hold onto you instead!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: You alright, Doctor?

options: I'm good.
I've gotten pretty used to it by now.
Next time, I can try running by myself.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Haha, glad you're doing well! Guess I can relax, then!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We've arrived at the designated location, Elysium.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Elysium?

steps.name: Intermittent Noise
steps.text: ...Don't...*bzzt*...stop...oving...*bzzt*—

steps.name: Intermittent Noise
steps.text: ...There's...*bzzt* *bzzt*...uards...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The line cut out.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The terminal says Elysium's still moving, but we don't have any way to reestablish communication.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's like short-range comms have been unstable ever since we entered Bresk.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There's also no way of telling if it's because of the Far North's extreme weather, or human interference.

options: I am curious, though...
Why would Bresk send so many guards to detain 'inter-city merchants'?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It is rather strange...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There haven't been any issues with the ID cards Closure forged for us.

options: Maybe we're not the ones they're watching out for.
Maybe they're watching us for different reasons.
But putting that aside...
Bresk is supposed to be a quiet city.
It's strange that it's so fortified.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This isn't anything like the intelligence we had... If this goes on, we won't make it into the mining district.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, shouldn't we rendezvous with Mantra's team and discuss—

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Doctor! Finally got you!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Keep moving! There are guards heading your way!

options: I think I figured that out, thanks...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: They're fast—

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Get behind me, Amiya!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, don't engage!

steps.name: Far North Soldier
steps.text: Alright, interloping scum, hands up!

options: Let's take a deep breath here.
What laws have we violated to cause such a fuss?

steps.name: Far North Soldier
steps.text: You trespassed in the industrial zone, and attempted to infiltrate a private factory, violating Bresk's migration regulations and Ursine urban public security measures.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Could I ask you to reconfirm, sir? When we entered the city, I'd never heard anything about a prohibition on foreigners entering the industrial zone—

steps.name: Far North Soldier
steps.text: It's a new regulation, went into effect just after you reached Bresk.

steps.name: Far North Soldier
steps.text: You will be detained under the law, and then Public Security will decide if you are to be deported or exiled, considering your circumstances.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If we inadvertently violated Bresk's new regulation, then I deeply apologize.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're just here to look for an inter-city merchant. It was stated clearly in the itinerary declaration we submitted upon entry to the city.

steps.name: Far North Soldier
steps.text: Save it for Public Security.

options: We didn't mean to offend.
There may be a way for both of us to save time here.
I believe Bresk, Pearl of the Far North, treats its guests well.
I'm sure the Grand Duchess is as kind as the rumors say.

steps.name: Far North Soldier
steps.text: Enough of that, I don't give a damn. I'm just doing my job.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Sir...

steps.name: Far North Soldier
steps.text: This way.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, sir. We can't delay any longer.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm sorry.
You see Amiya shift her body, surreptitiously protecting you. Mon3tr observes your surroundings, looking for a way out.

steps.name: Far North Soldier
steps.text: You don't know how things work around here.

steps.name: Far North Soldier
steps.text: Get them.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Warning roar)

steps.name: Hesitant Soldier
steps.text: Err... Ah!

steps.name: Far North Soldier
steps.text: What are you standing around for?! Get in there already!

steps.name: Far North Soldier
steps.text: What, can't even handle a little Feline girl?

steps.name: Hesitant Soldier
steps.text: S...Sir, look behind them.

steps.name: Hesitant Soldier
steps.text: That looks like th-th-the—

steps.name: Far North Soldier
steps.text: Spit it out already!

steps.name: Hesitant Soldier
steps.text: —The Imperial Guard!

steps.name: Far North Soldier
steps.text: Yerunda! Those pretentious bastards should be in Grypherburg, what would they be doing in Bresk?

spans.text: Those pretentious bastards should be in Grypherburg, what would they be doing in Bresk?

steps.name: Hesitant Soldier
steps.text: B-But those clothes—

steps.name: Imperial Guard?
steps.text: I am terribly sorry, sir, but I'm afraid she is right this time.

steps.name: Far North Soldier
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Imperial Guard?
steps.text: Eloysius Gorchekova, Sergeant of the Imperial Guard, Vanguard Battalion, here from Deity Grypherburg.

steps.name: Far North Soldier
steps.text: What are you playing at?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I have a simple request for you. Overlook this little breach of protocol and release our pitiful guests.

steps.name: Far North Soldier
steps.text: You're with them?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Unfortunately, they are indeed my friends. Since you are now aware of my history with them, surely you'll do me this favor, yes?

steps.name: Far North Soldier
steps.text: We're a long way from Grypherburg, why should I care about that?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Because I stopped by Public Security and filled out all the paperwork?
The young Ursus waves some papers in her hand. In the dusky gloom of polar night, none can clearly see what is written on them.

steps.name: Far North Soldier
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: If I were you, sir, I wouldn't play around with my future like that.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: There are many lost travelers, but rarely a chance to curry favor with the Imperial Guard—Ah, yes, may I ask you your name, or your service number?

steps.name: Far North Soldier
steps.text: Alright, Sergeant Gorchekova. I'll report all this to Public Security. You may go.

steps.name: Far North Soldier
steps.text: May your authority be as eternally glorious as the Tsar himself.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Thank you for the kind words, sir.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: But none has as eternal a glory as His Imperial Majesty. The rest of us will have to leave the stage when the time comes.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Well, I'll be off with our guests for now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Thank you for helping us get out of that sticky situation, ma'am... but, why exactly did you—

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Shh, they're still close by.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Also, my cute little Cautus, you may call me Eloysius.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: 'Ma'am' is too formal, while 'Guardswoman' or 'girl' is too crude. I believe names are what's best for our current relationship.

options: Thank you for the help, Eloysius.
You really know how to handle those guards.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: They most likely thought you were ordinary traders, easy to shake down for a quick chervonets or two, same way they treat Columbian sightseers.

spans.text: They most likely thought you were ordinary traders, easy to shake down for a quick
or two, same way they treat Columbian sightseers.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: But you're hardly tourists or traders, now, are you?

options: Let's cut to the chase.
Why are you helping us?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Good, good, I appreciate candor. I will answer your questions, but not here.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Once you have gathered your friends, we can go somewhere far from prying eyes and ears.

options: We don't have much time.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Relax, I won't be wasting your time. This is all in service of your goal.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Well, here we are.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Where is here?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: An abandoned apartment. As far as I know, the guards don't care for these nigh-empty old districts.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: An empty plate may sound wasteful, but it is true. No matter how the Deity Grypherburg Times tries to cover it up, it is a widely-known fact that the population of the Far Northern cities has been dwindling these last few years.

spans.text: An empty plate may sound wasteful, but it is true. No matter how the
tries to cover it up, it is a widely-known fact that the population of the Far Northern cities has been dwindling these last few years.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: As time goes by, this place becomes deserted, and the plate will be discarded, left to rust in the wilderness like all the other abandoned plates.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Eloysius, we need to know exactly why you came looking for us. Now, ideally.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Vigilant stare)

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Could I ask everyone to lighten up a little, please?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: There are a lot of you and only one of me. What kind of threat could I possibly pose to people of your caliber?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Could I ask the Phidia lady standing outside the door to tell your friends that I'm not lying?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Captain says there's nobody else here. The district is safe.

options: Choosing this place to talk means you also need to be covert.
I had hoped the Imperial Guard would at least treat us to dinner.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: A friend of mine used to live here. She had hoped to achieve her dream of completing a saga for the Ursine people, but was defeated by the frigid cold—She is doing very well in Grypherburg, I should add.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: But thanks to her, we have this place to shelter both from the cold wind, and from people snooping around.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I'm sure I'm not the only one here who wants to stay out of trouble.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: You're a funny one, my hooded friend. It takes a clever mind to grasp humor.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Once we have discussed our important business, I would be happy to entertain you with a meal if you are all still interested.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Firstly, since I've already introduced myself, may I have the pleasure of knowing your names?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We've come from Victoria and—

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Still insisting that you went into the industrial zone to meet with an inter-city merchant, a widow who goes by the name of Olga?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: A very reliable cover story, one that will fool a vast majority of the city's port officials.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: But no matter how you put it, it is rare for a commercial party in a nomadic city to be using military-grade encrypted communications.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Was it you intercepting our communications?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: No, no, I would never do something so crude.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: It may have been the aurora, or the recently upgraded defense equipment. You truly are unlucky, coming to Bresk during the most interesting times it has ever seen.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I have been honest on my part. If you still have things you wish to keep hidden, then I am afraid we have to break things off here.

options: We're a pharmaceutical company.
Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: See? Honesty isn't so painful, is it?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Rhodes Island... I have heard this name mentioned many times while investigating Infected rumors from all across the land.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Based on what I have pieced together from these tales, you lot are the stuff of legends.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: But no matter how true they are, the most recent instance I have encountered your name was in that paper you published about aberrant changes in the Infected.

options: You don't strike me as a colleague in the field.
I never thought you'd be interested in Oripathy studies.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Pardon me for letting you down, but not every newly-minted Grypherburg noble is an uneducated lout.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: There is not a nation on this land that can overlook the Infected question, though their policies in answering it may differ. Anyone with a modicum of common sense would know just how important this scientific achievement of yours is.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: But there is one thing I am curious about. Despite this groundbreaking discovery, Rhodes Island has kept a low profile, instead of using it to do more business.

options: Is that why you came to find us?
This doesn't explain how you knew our whereabouts.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Oh, that can easily be explained. I think anyone who goes into the Far North's Central Mining District right now is doing it for the same reason.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You mean you also want in?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: What, do you not?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We... need to get in.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Sure enough.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: You don't have a way into the mining district, and as it turns out, I have need of some Oripathy specialists. The perfect recipe for cooperation.

options: So you want us to go into the district with you?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: The authorities here will not look kindly on some Grypherburger sticking her nose into Far Northern affairs, after all.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: As things are, your cover as merchants will do you no good, nor will it help me, so let's forget all the masks and red tape and shake hands right here. That is one solution to all our problems.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But what is it you want to do in the district? And what do you need from us?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Was I not clear?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I'm hoping Rhodes Island will accompany me into the mining district to collaborate on an investigation into the Infected affair.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The 'Infected affair'? What exactly are you referring to...?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Oh, my dear, sweet, naive little Cautus, my patience has its limits, you know. There is no time to be playing dumb.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, that's a serious question.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We lost contact with one of our mobile medical teams in the Far North's Central Mining District, and we need to find them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We really have no idea what this 'Infected affair' is, and I hope you will elaborate.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: You want into the district just for—

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Wait, so you really don't know?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: That's impossible. To my knowledge, you've built many more medical posts all across Ursus in the past few years—
Simple doubt replaces the suspicion on the young woman's face, before finally shifting to a sudden realization.
She understands how her assumptions have led her astray.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: —No. You just said 'mobile medical team'...

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: No fixed offices means no steady access to a network of contacts with the latest intelligence. I don't know what issues Rhodes Island is currently facing, but it seems the information you have is limited.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: And because this is Ursus, you have been unable to do much. Because of your lack of information, you have been blindly running into walls this whole time... Haven't you?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Chyort poberi! I was too impatient.

options: We really don't know what this 'Infected affair' is.
Does it have to do with Bresk's current state of affairs?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Forget it. Forget I said anything. That favor before was free of charge, no need to thank me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Wait!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The very fact that you came looking for us means there is the possibility we can work together on this.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Could you not tell us what exactly happened in the mining district?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I really... Gah! I really should have thought things through more before making a choice.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: And here I was, thinking you were racking your brains on how to enter the district upon hearing the news. You should know that this information is worth quite a lot on the black market.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're not that kind of organization... but that doesn't matter right now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We have a natural reason to be invested in anything to do with the Infected. That's why you came looking for us, wasn't it?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Please, tell us.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Fine, fine! Since I'm already here, I may as well do something, even if it is just for some Infected.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Infected are Ursine citizens, too.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: You are correct, precious little Cautus. The Infected are indeed Ursines, and that is before we mention those miners that the Tsar personally promised 'life, not survival'.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: The miners are the backbone of Ursus, keeping its war machines running. A fact that those corrupt old nobles and their puppets haven't realized yet.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: But even they must know that Ursus must change.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: My word, what am I even babbling about...? Good thing those sharp-tongued, poison-spitting colleagues of mine aren't here, or they would laugh me into my grave.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You should not feel ashamed for this.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Spoken words are like spilled cystymilk: they freeze solid in this weather.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: So what is this 'Infected affair'? It sounds like it has to do with the Infected miners?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Listen, if you dare leak any of this...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You have my word that no matter what you have to say, we will not disclose it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There is no benefit to making an enemy out of Ursus. We know that well.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Give me a moment, I need to figure out where to start...

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: You know, of course, that Bresk borders the Far North's Central Mining District, and is also the largest nomadic city in the north of Ursus.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: This means the city administrates a total of thirty thousand square kilometers' worth of mines scattered across the Far North, alongside two hundred thousand Infected.

options: We are familiar with the basic facts of this place.
What issues arise in this sort of system?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Please don't look at me like that... Sorry, I knew this sort of talk would anger you.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: But the Tsar does not wish for these Infected miners to be treated as cheap labor. On the contrary, his decrees have shown a lot of care for the people of Bresk.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Things have been going rather smoothly in the city these past few years, until three months ago...

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Yes, this is where your company's area of expertise comes in, along with that paper.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Three months ago, large numbers of 'abnormal Infected' were discovered in the Central Mining District. Their symptoms were very similar to the ones described in your paper.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Three months ago? Wasn't that...?)

options: You mean...?
That's the reason why Bresk is under martial law?
How many 'abnormal' Infected are there in the district?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: That's the question.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Right now, nobody knows just how many 'normal' Infected are left in the Central Mining District.
